events.summary: Takeno's hound Isamaru senses the coming kami and Takeno orders the guard alerted.
events.quote: General Takeno looked down at the faithful Isamaru and calmed him with a touch. "Alert the guard. The kami are coming."

events.summary: Oketra's shot pierces Gideon's pegasus over Ravnica, and he falls holding the Blackblade.
events.quote: Ravnica's defenders watched in horror as Oketra's shot pierced the body of the pegasus. Gideon tumbled through the air, Blackblade in hand.

events.summary: The Derby Crows join the renegades in open revolt against the Consulate.
events.quote: The daredevil racers of the Derby Crows, long at odds with the Consulate, were quick to join the renegades in open revolt.

events.summary: After conquering Shandalar's depths, Talrand turns his ambitions skyward.
events.quote: After Talrand conquered the depths of Shandalar, his ambitions drove him skyward

events.summary: Selesnya missionaries in the Shanav Quarter meet scorn and martyrdom.
events.quote: When Selesnya missionaries moved into the Shanav Quarter, they faced scorn, ridicule, and ultimately martyrdom.

events.summary: Tasigur frees a Mardu warrior with a cruel smile.
events.quote: The Mardu warrior was overjoyed when Tasigur set him free and granted him passage through the jungle.

events.summary: Kalitas returns to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi, and Drana vows never again.
events.quote: Kalitas may have returned to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi, but we say never again.

events.summary: Opening Orazca unleashes horrors along with the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.

events.summary: Liliana is freed of a contract only her binder's death could end.
events.quote: You bound me with a contract only your death could end—and you thought me the fool?

events.summary: Grimnant knights bully an Urborg corpse shop owner and die.
events.quote: The first mistake the Grimnant knights made was bullying the owner of an Urborg corpse shop. Their second mistake was dying.

events.summary: After triumph over Mogis's forces, Brygus praises the Champion, who mourns eight graves.
events.quote: "I count eight graves," she said. "Too many to call this a victory."

events.summary: Chandra answers Dovin Baan's sabotage in the hold of the Heart of Kiran.
events.quote: In the hold of the *Heart of Kiran*, Chandra answered Dovin Baan's sabotage with an explosive retort.

events.summary: Sea Gate is retaken by everyone who could still fight.
events.quote: Everyone who could still lift a weapon had a part in retaking Sea Gate.

events.summary: Eidren has hundreds of trees uprooted and rearranged, creating the Gilt-Leaf Wood.
events.quote: Thus the Gilt-Leaf Wood was born.

events.summary: The shards merge into the Maelstrom, fusing mana into new monstrosities.
events.quote: As the shards merged into the Maelstrom, their mana energies fused into new monstrosities.

events.summary: During the Khanfall, dragons came to rule Tarkir.
events.quote: when the dragons came to rule Tarkir and its people aligned themselves with the five dragonlords.

events.summary: Ugin tells Jace the hedrons can imprison the Eldrazi; Jace doubts it.
events.quote: "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned." "And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.
